module: "Vehicle Config Provider" provider node (`simple` behavior, category `provider`). Lets the user pick a vehicle model and config in the editor (`ui_flowgraph_editor.vehicleSelector`). Outputs: `model`, `config` (config path), `modelName` and `configName` (hidden).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores model, config, path, type and names.

_onSerialize.desc: Saves model, config, path, type and names.

work.desc: Writes the chosen model and config to the outputs.
